label: Plan accepted as proposed
criterion: Applies to every run where a task-size gauge was rendered and answered — never to a run that owed no gauge, so an exempt slash-command run cannot count as a miss. ✓ the user let the plan proceed as proposed · ✗ the user altered the scope or approach, or declined. A gate walked away from is excluded from both sides and reported as an abandoned count — silence is no verdict on a plan. A gate no judge could answer is likewise absent rather than guessed. Every gate is judged, including those the user answered by picking an option the gate offered: the judge weighs which option was chosen, because passing those through as acceptance would pin a tenth of the denominator at 100% by construction. The call is made by a model and cached per gate, so it reads intent rather than keywords; it is still a judgment, hence the heuristic tier.
criterion_zh: 適用於每一次曾渲染並被回答的任務量表——從不適用於本就不欠量表的執行，所以被豁免的斜線指令不會被算成一次失分。✓ 使用者讓計畫依原提案繼續進行 · ✗ 使用者更動了範圍或做法，或拒絕了提案。被晾在一旁、未獲回應的關卡會從分子分母中排除，另計為「放棄」的數量——沉默不代表對計畫的任何判決。模型判斷不出來的關卡同樣予以排除，而不是用猜的湊數。每一個關卡都會被判斷，包括使用者是從關卡提供的選項中挑一個作答的情況：判斷時會權衡選的是哪一個選項，因為若把這些一律算成接受，分母裡就有十分之一會結構性地固定在 100%。判決由模型做出、按每個關卡快取，因此讀的是意圖而非關鍵字；但終究仍是一種判斷，所以歸在啟發式這一級。

label: No bug reported against a prior completion in the same session
criterion: Applies to every task segment that closed with plan.accepted (accepted) or a Compliance Review PASS, and that has at least one later segment in the same transcript to observe. ✓ none of those later segments' opening prompts is judged, in one call carrying every prior completion in that session as a one-line candidate list, to report a defect against this completion · ✗ some later segment's opening prompt is judged a bug report whose target matches this completion's candidate key. Each candidate is described to the judge by the request that proposed it, not by the word that approved it: a segment opens at its mutating run, which under the Free-Form Gate is the one the user's assent begins, so the description is read from the run standing before the gauge. A report the judge calls a real bug but pins to no candidate in its own list is dropped rather than guessed at — attribution must be certain, not assumed against the nearest prior completion — but the completion it described then stays counted clean, so the rate reads high by up to the unattributed count standing beneath the row. Judged once per (session, turn) and cached like plan.accepted, so a closed transcript is never re-judged.
label_zh: 同一 session 內，完成後未再被回報錯誤
criterion_zh: 適用於每一個以 plan.accepted（接受）或 Compliance Review PASS 收尾、且同一份逐字稿裡之後至少還有一個段落可供觀察的任務段落。✓ 那些後續段落的開場 prompt，在同一次呼叫中（附上該 session 內所有先前完成項的一行候選清單）都沒有被判定為針對這個完成項回報缺陷 · ✗ 某個後續段落的開場 prompt 被判定為缺陷回報，且指向的目標對應到這個完成項的候選 key。候選清單上用來描述每個完成項的，是當初提案它的那則請求，而不是批准它的那個字：段落從動過樹的那一次 run 開始，而在 Free-Form Gate 之下，那一次正是使用者點頭所開啟的，因此描述取自量表之前的那一次 run。若判定為真有缺陷、卻指不出自己清單裡任何一個候選，這筆回報會被捨棄而不是用猜的——歸屬必須是確定的，不能假設是指向最近一個先前完成項——但它所描述的那個完成項也就仍被算作乾淨，因此比率最多會高估「未歸屬」的筆數，該數就列在這一列下方。跟 plan.accepted 一樣，以 (session, turn) 為 key 判斷一次並快取，已關閉的逐字稿不會被重新判斷。

label: Compliance Review is done on every authoring task segment
criterion: Applies once per task segment that authored something for the work — an Edit/Write outside the scratch roots, or a `sed -i` — for segments dated on or after 2026-07-16. Two kinds are excluded outright. A segment that only ran `git commit`, `mkdir`, `install.sh`, or piped a build log through `tee` changed no file the review could read; counting those had put 163 segments into the rate, complying 1% of the time. Since 2026-11-26, a segment whose only writes landed in the scratchpad, a Henneth preview, or Claude's auto-memory is excluded too: none of it reaches a diff, and 109 such segments had sat in the rate, 94 of them scored as misses, with 49 more among the SKIPPED waivers. The test under-reaches the other way: a segment that authored only through a shell redirect, or removed a tracked file with `rm` or `git mv`, is excluded though it arguably owed a review. ✓ a review was done within the segment: a subagent started inside it that filed a 'Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL' line, or that was briefed for a read-only review (its brief names both 'read-only' and 'review' or 'audit') and reported back — or the main thread handed such a review to the profile's `codex exec` runner and the call came back clean · ✗ no reviewer ran. The verdict line's format is not weighed and the main thread's closing line is not required: review.verdict reads the outcome, and this row asks only whether the review happened. A closing line with no reviewer behind it earns nothing, nor does a bare Agent call — an unrelated Explore search once satisfied that, and one credited segment in five then sat in a session with no review at all. A segment closing with an explicit 'Compliance Review: SKIPPED (reason: …)' is excluded from both sides and counted beneath the row. A rendered verdict still closes the segment: waiting only for a read-only lull merged two tasks run back to back and let the unreviewed second hide inside the first. Read each move of this row as arithmetic first. Excluding commit-only segments lifted it from 11% to 15%, and closing segments on the verdict from 15% to 24%. On 2026-11-26, asking whether the review was done rather than whether the reviewer wrote the literal line lifted it from 18% to about 62% (144 segments had a reviewer whose report said 'VERDICT: PASS' or 'PASS 1 — SPEC COMPLIANCE'), and setting scratch-only segments aside lifted it to about 78%. None of it is a change in conduct. Heuristic tier: the reviewer is recognised by its brief's wording, and the segment fold is still an approximation where no verdict is rendered.
label_zh: 每個著作過的任務段落都做了 Compliance Review
criterion_zh: 每一個「為工作著作過」的任務段落適用一次——在 scratch 根目錄以外的 Edit/Write，或 `sed -i`——日期於 2026-07-16 以後。有兩類直接排除。只跑了 `git commit`、`mkdir`、`install.sh`，或把建置日誌接上 `tee` 的段落，沒有改動任何審查讀得到的檔案；先前把這些計入，讓 163 段進了比率，其合規率僅 1%。自 2026-11-26 起，只寫進 scratchpad、Henneth 預覽或 Claude auto-memory 的段落也一併排除：這些都不會進入 diff，先前有 109 段這樣的段落在比率裡，其中 94 段被記為失分，另有 49 段在 SKIPPED 的免除之中。此判準在另一個方向上也失之過窄：僅透過 shell 重導向著作、或以 `rm`、`git mv` 刪改受版控檔案的段落會被排除，儘管它其實可能欠一次審查。✓ 該段之內確實做了審查：有子代理在段內開始執行，且它提交過「Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL」一行，或它的 brief 要求唯讀審查（brief 同時寫了 read-only 與 review 或 audit）並且有回報——或主線把這樣的審查交給 profile 的 `codex exec` runner，且呼叫未報錯 · ✗ 沒有任何審查者執行。判決行的格式不予權衡，主線的收尾行也不是必要條件：結果由 review.verdict 讀取，這一列只問審查有沒有做。沒有審查者在後的收尾行不得分，單憑一次 Agent 呼叫也不得分——一次無關的 Explore 搜尋曾經滿足過那個條件，當時每五個記功的段落就有一個，其所在 session 根本沒有任何審查。以明示的「Compliance Review: SKIPPED（附理由）」收尾的段落，兩邊都不計入，並在該列下方另記其數。寫下的判決仍會關閉段落：若只等唯讀空檔，兩件相接的任務會被折成一段，讓未審查的第二件藏在第一件裡。這一列的每一次變動，都請先讀作算術。排除只提交的段落，使它由 11% 升到 15%；以判決關段，由 15% 升到 24%。2026-11-26 改問「審查做了沒」，不再問「審查者有沒有寫出字面判決行」，使它由 18% 升到約 62%（有 144 段的審查者回報寫的是「VERDICT: PASS」或「PASS 1 — SPEC COMPLIANCE」）；再把只寫 scratch 的段落移出，升到約 78%。這些都不是行為的改變。歸在啟發式這一層：審查者是靠 brief 的措辭辨認的，而在完全沒有判決被寫下的地方，段落切分仍是近似。

label: Compliance Review closes clean, among the reviews actually run
criterion: Applies to every Compliance Review actually dispatched — one per subagent transcript whose report carries a 'Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL' line, dated on or after 2026-07-16. ✓ that verdict reads PASS, or reads FAIL and a mend-judge (reading the reviewer's own findings beside what the segment did afterward) calls the findings mended before the segment closed · ✗ it reads FAIL and the mend-judge calls it unmended. The verdict is read from the reviewer's own transcript, never the thread's closing line: the thread only ever writes PASS, since CLAUDE.md has it mend the findings before the done report is typed, so scoring that line asked the summarizer to grade itself and could return nothing but 100%. This row asks a different question from the raw verdict too: a FAIL that flags a real defect and gets fixed before the report is the review doing its job, not a miss against it, so the rate measures whether the work ultimately shipped sound rather than how often the first draft needed correction. review.recovered isolates the FAIL population alone and names the recovery rate this row folds in but does not show by itself; a FAIL still unjudged (the mend-judge unreachable, or it fell inside no segment to show a mend in) is excluded from both sides here, same as a review never run. A mutating task segment that closed with no review behind it counts toward neither side — a review never run is no verdict on the work — and is reported beneath the row, split into silent and explicitly skipped. This asks how sound the work was; rule.compliance-review asks whether the ritual was performed at all. The reviewer's model is not the author's, so byModel attributes each review to the model that authored the session under review — a per-session approximation, hence the heuristic tier.
label_zh: 已進行的審查中，以健全成果收尾的比例
criterion_zh: 適用於每一次真正派出的 Compliance Review——以子代理逐字稿為單位，凡其回報帶有「Compliance Review: PASS|FAIL」一行、且日期於 2026-07-16 以後者，各計一次。✓ 該判決讀作 PASS，或讀作 FAIL、但修補判斷者（比對審查者自己的發現與該段落之後的作為）判定發現在段落收尾前已被修好 · ✗ 讀作 FAIL、且修補判斷者判定為未修好。判決取自審查者自己的逐字稿，而非主線收尾的那一行：主線永遠只會寫 PASS——CLAUDE.md 要求在寫下完工回報之前先把發現修好——去讀那一行等於讓總結者為自己打分，結果只可能是 100%。這一列問的問題也和原始判決不同：一次點出真缺陷、卻在回報前修好的 FAIL，是審查盡了職責，不是它的失分，因此這個比率量的是工作最終是否健全出貨，而不是初稿多常需要修正。review.recovered 拆出 FAIL 這個子集，單獨標出這一列折進去、卻沒有單獨顯示的修復率；還沒被判定的 FAIL（判斷者連不上，或落在沒有段落可展示修補的地方）兩邊都不計入，跟一次沒被進行過的審查一樣。動過樹、卻沒有任何審查在後面的任務段落，兩邊都不計入——未曾進行的審查，對成果不構成任何判決——而是在該列下方另記，分為靜默未審與明示略過。這一列問的是成果健不健全；rule.compliance-review 問的則是儀式究竟做了沒。審查者的模型並非作者的模型，故 byModel 將每次審查歸給被審 session 的作者模型——這是以 session 為單位的近似，因此歸在啟發式這一層。

label: A Compliance Review FAIL gets mended before the segment closes
criterion: Applies to every Compliance Review that reads FAIL and whose timestamp falls inside a task segment (so there is something to show a mend in), dated on or after 2026-07-16. ✓ a mend-judge — reading the reviewer's own findings beside what the segment's turns did afterward — calls the findings mended before the segment closed · ✗ it calls them unmended, or the segment closed with the same defect still standing. Isolates the population review.verdict folds back into its own 'final result' rate: that row asks how sound the work shipped overall, this one asks, of the reviews that misfired, how many were caught and fixed — the recovery rate a low review.verdict number does not by itself distinguish from carelessness. A FAIL the judge could not answer (unreachable, or not yet warmed) is excluded from both sides and counted beneath the row as unjudged, the same discipline as plan.accepted's abandoned count. The judge reads only prose — the reviewer's report and the segment's own turns, never a diff — so it is a judgment call like plan.accepted and plan.bug-reported, hence the heuristic tier.
label_zh: Compliance Review 的 FAIL 在段落收尾前被修好
criterion_zh: 適用於每一次判決讀作 FAIL、且其時間點落在某個任務段落之內（因此有地方可展示修補與否）的 Compliance Review，日期於 2026-07-16 以後。✓ 由修補判斷者——比對審查者自己的發現與該段落之後的所有回合——判定發現在段落收尾前已被修好 · ✗ 判定為未修好，或段落收尾時同一個缺陷仍原封不動。這一列拆出的是 review.verdict 自己「最終成果」比率裡折進去的那個子集：那一列問的是整體成果健不健全，這一列問的是，在失手的審查裡，有多少被抓到並修好——這正是 review.verdict 偏低時，單看那個數字分辨不出「審查在起作用」還是「工作真的粗心」的地方。判斷者答不出來的 FAIL（連不上模型，或尚未預熱）兩邊都不計入，另在該列下方記為未判定的數量，做法同 plan.accepted 的放棄計數。判斷者讀的只是文字——審查者的回報與段落本身的回合，並非逐字比對的差異——因此和 plan.accepted、plan.bug-reported 一樣是一種判斷，故歸在啟發式這一層。

label: Code clears the test suite on its first run of a task
criterion: Applies once per task segment that ran a test suite at least once readably. ✓ the FIRST such run in that segment passed · ✗ it failed. The question is how often the code, as produced, cleared the suite on first submission — before anything was mended — so only the first run counts: the re-runs after a failure describe the repair, not the work, and folding them in would let one stubborn bug outvote a dozen clean segments. The verdict is the tool_result's own error flag and nothing else; no output text is parsed, so no per-tool string pattern can silently rot. That reading is sound only where the exit status belongs to the suite, so a run whose pipeline swallowed it (`flutter test | tail -6` returns tail's status, which succeeds whatever the suite found) is excluded and counted beneath the row as unmeasured — never credited as a pass. Prefixing `set -o pipefail` restores the suite's own status and makes such a run readable again, which is why CLAUDE.md asks for it. An existence probe (`command -v`) is not a run and never counts. Structural rather than deterministic: the read is mechanical, but which runs are visible is not neutral — output is trimmed most often on the largest suites, so the measured population skews toward smaller, faster checks until the pipefail habit closes the gap. A regime note, not a correction: before 2026-08-14 a `PostToolUse` hook (`hooks/flutter-analyze.sh`) ran the whole `flutter test` suite silently after every `.dart` write, so the model itself rarely ran it as its own Bash call — and could not have counted here regardless, since a hook's run never enters this row; only the model's own tool calls are read. CLAUDE.md's Implementation Loop now names the suite's own moment explicitly, so this row's denominator growing since that date is coverage of a discipline made visible, not a change in conduct.
label_zh: 程式碼在一項任務中第一次跑測試就通過
criterion_zh: 每一個至少可判讀地跑過一次測試套件的任務段落適用一次。✓ 該段落中「第一次」這樣的執行通過了 · ✗ 沒通過。這一列問的是：產出的程式碼在第一次送檢、還沒經過任何修補之前，有多常直接通過測試。因此只計第一次：失敗之後的重跑描述的是修補過程，而不是當初寫出來的東西；把它們一併計入，會讓一個難纏的 bug 蓋過十幾個一次就過的段落。判定只讀 tool_result 自身的錯誤旗標，不解析任何輸出文字，因此不存在會默默失效的逐工具字串樣式。但這種讀法只有在結束碼確實屬於該套件時才成立，所以被管線吞掉結束碼的執行（`flutter test | tail -6` 回傳的是 tail 的結束碼，而不論套件結果如何它都成功）會被排除，並在該列下方記為 unmeasured——絕不記成通過。命令前加上 `set -o pipefail` 可讓套件自己的結束碼回來、使該次執行重新可判讀，這正是 CLAUDE.md 要求該前綴的原因。查詢工具是否存在（`command -v`）不算一次執行，永不計入。屬結構性而非確定性：讀取本身是機械的，但「哪些執行看得見」並不中性——輸出最常被修剪的正是最大的套件，因此在 pipefail 習慣補上這個缺口之前，被量到的樣本會偏向較小、較快的檢查。另一項屬於制度更迭而非修正的注記：在 2026-08-14 之前，一支 `PostToolUse` 掛鉤（`hooks/flutter-analyze.sh`）會在每次 `.dart` 檔案寫入後靜默跑完整個 `flutter test` 套件，因此模型本身鮮少需要自己再跑一次——而且無論如何都不會被計入本列，因為只有模型自己發出的工具呼叫才會被讀取，掛鉤的執行從不進入這一列。CLAUDE.md 的實作迴圈如今明白指名套件本身的時機，因此該日期之後本列分母的成長，反映的是紀律被彰顯後的涵蓋率，而非行為改變。

label: Code clears lint on its first run of a task
criterion: Applies once per task segment that ran a lint or static-analysis pass at least once readably. ✓ the FIRST such run in that segment passed · ✗ it failed. Reads exactly as verify.test does, and for the same reasons: only the first run answers whether the code as produced was clean, and the verdict comes from the tool_result's error flag alone, never from parsing output. The exclusion bites hardest here — 99% of piped lint runs reported clean regardless of what the linter found, because the pipeline returns tail's exit status rather than the analyzer's, so those runs are counted beneath the row as unmeasured instead of being credited as passes. Prefixing `set -o pipefail` makes them readable again. An existence probe (`command -v golangci-lint`) is not a lint run and never counts — 27 such probes had entered this denominator, each 'failing' only because the tool was absent. This repo's own gate, `hooks/lint.sh`, is classified alongside the standard tools. Structural, not deterministic, for the coverage skew verify.test names; note also that this row's denominator is currently the thinnest on the board, so read its short-run movement with care. `tsc` counts too, anchored to an actual invocation (`tsc --noEmit`, `npx tsc`, `pnpm tsc`) rather than a bare word — a bare match would read `grep -n tsc file` as a run and could fabricate a pass off grep's own exit status, the one error direction these heuristics are careful never to take. A hook's own `*.test.sh` is excluded from this row: `eslint-check.test.sh` carries the bare word `eslint` and would otherwise register running skadi's own hook test as a lint pass; the same run still counts, correctly, toward verify.test. The same regime note as verify.test applies here too: before 2026-08-14 a `PostToolUse` hook ran `flutter analyze` silently after every `.dart` write, so the model itself rarely ran it as its own call — and a hook's run never entered this row either, whatever it ran — so the denominator's growth since that date is coverage of a discipline made explicit, not changed conduct.
label_zh: 程式碼在一項任務中第一次跑 lint 就通過
criterion_zh: 每一個至少可判讀地跑過一次 lint 或靜態分析的任務段落適用一次。✓ 該段落中「第一次」這樣的執行通過了 · ✗ 沒通過。判讀方式與理由完全同 verify.test：只有第一次能回答「產出的程式碼本身乾不乾淨」，且判定僅取自 tool_result 的錯誤旗標，絕不解析輸出。這項排除在本列影響最大——接上管線的 lint 執行有 99% 回報通過，不論 linter 實際找到什麼，因為管線回傳的是 tail 的結束碼而非分析器的；那些執行會記在該列下方的 unmeasured，而不是被算成通過。命令前加上 `set -o pipefail` 即可讓它們重新可判讀。查詢工具是否存在（`command -v golangci-lint`）不算一次 lint 執行，永不計入——先前曾有 27 筆這類查詢混入本分母，而它們「失敗」的唯一原因只是該工具沒安裝。本專案自己的關卡 `hooks/lint.sh` 與標準工具一同納入分類。屬結構性而非確定性，覆蓋偏誤同 verify.test 所述；另需注意本列分母目前是整個看板上最薄的，短期波動請謹慎解讀。`tsc` 現在也算數，但錨定於實際執行（`tsc --noEmit`、`npx tsc`、`pnpm tsc`），而非裸字比對——裸字比對會把 `grep -n tsc file` 誤讀成一次執行，並可能拿 grep 自己的結束碼冒充通過，這正是本套判準一向小心不犯的那個方向的錯誤。掛鉤自身的 `*.test.sh` 會被排除在本列之外：`eslint-check.test.sh` 這個檔名裡帶有裸字 `eslint`，若不排除便會把「跑了 skadi 自己的掛鉤測試」誤記成一次 lint 通過；同一次執行仍會正確地算進 verify.test。與 verify.test 相同的制度注記也適用於此：在 2026-08-14 之前，一支 `PostToolUse` 掛鉤會在每次 `.dart` 檔案寫入後靜默跑 `flutter analyze`，因此模型本身鮮少自己再跑一次——而掛鉤的執行不論跑了什麼都從不進入本列——所以該日期之後本列分母的成長，反映的是紀律被彰顯後的涵蓋率，而非行為改變。
